notes: Original SQ-6 (not the newer "SQ-6+" variant, which has a 9" touchscreen and RackUltra FX). Desktop control-surface mixer, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted); dimensions 638x514.9x198mm. 24 local mic preamps (0-60dB gain, switchable -20dB pad, +48V phantom, +30dBu max input, fully recallable). 14 XLR + 2 TRS local line outputs, +4dBu nominal/+22dBu max, source fully patchable to any bus (outputs 11/12 are additionally silkscreened "L"/"R" as the default Main assignment). SLink is a Neutrik locking EtherCON (RJ45-based) port carrying dSnake (48kHz, 40 in/20+40 ME out), DX (96kHz, 32x32) or GigaACE/GX (96kHz, 128x128) protocols to Allen & Heath DX/AudioRack expanders and ME personal-mixing systems; the datasheet does not state a numeric link speed so no "grade" was set (industry material elsewhere describes SLink/GigaACE as Gigabit Ethernet-based, but that is not confirmed in this source). The "I/O Port" is a 64x64 option-card expansion slot (Dante, Waves, MADI or A&H SLink/ACE cards, sold separately); the base unit ships with no card fitted, so its true connector depends on the card installed — represented here as a single RJ45-type bidirectional port per the rear-panel diagram, with low confidence on that specific connector choice. Footswitch connector type (1/4" TRS) is inferred from the rear-panel line drawing and standard A&H footswitch accessories; the datasheet text itself only says "footswitch connection," not an explicit connector type. USB-A "SQ-Drive" is on the top control surface (not the rear panel); USB-B, AES out, SLink, I/O Port, Network, Footswitch and AC power are rear-panel; ST3 (3.5mm) and Phones are on the top surface.

ports.name: Mic/Line In 24
ports.note: Balanced XLR, digitally-controlled recallable preamp: 0 to +60dB gain (1dB steps), switchable -20dB pad, +48V phantom power, +30dBu max input with pad.

ports.name: Talkback Mic In
ports.note: Dedicated talkback microphone input with gain, pad and 48V; assignable to any output mix.

ports.name: ST1 In
ports.note: Balanced 1/4" TRS. Forms a stereo pair with ST2 (ST1 = Left).

ports.name: ST2 In
ports.note: Balanced 1/4" TRS. Forms a stereo pair with ST1 (ST2 = Right).

ports.name: ST3 In
ports.note: Unbalanced stereo 3.5mm mini-jack on the top control surface (e.g. phone/tablet playback).

ports.name: Line Out 11
ports.note: Rear panel additionally prints a default "L" (Main Left) designation; source is fully patchable to any bus.

ports.name: Line Out 12
ports.note: Rear panel additionally prints a default "R" (Main Right) designation; source is fully patchable to any bus.

ports.name: Line Out 13
ports.note: Balanced XLR, +4dBu nominal/+22dBu max output, source fully patchable.

ports.name: Line Out 14
ports.note: Balanced XLR, +4dBu nominal/+22dBu max output, source fully patchable.

ports.name: Output A
ports.note: Balanced 1/4" TRS line output; source fully patchable.

ports.name: Output B
ports.note: Balanced 1/4" TRS line output; source fully patchable.

ports.name: AES Out
ports.note: Balanced XLR, 2-channel AES/EBU digital output, switchable sample rate 44.1/48/88.2/96kHz.

ports.name: Phones
ports.note: 1/4" TRS headphone output with dedicated level control, on the control surface.

ports.name: Footswitch
ports.note: Accepts single or dual footswitch, momentary or latching, assignable function. Connector type inferred from the rear-panel line drawing; datasheet text only says "footswitch connection" without naming the connector.

ports.name: SLink
ports.note: Neutrik locking EtherCON (RJ45-based) AoIP expansion port. Carries dSnake (48kHz: 40 in / 20+40(ME) out), DX (96kHz: 32x32) or GigaACE/GX (96kHz: 128x128) protocols to Allen & Heath DX/AudioRack expanders and ME personal-mixing systems. No numeric link speed stated in the datasheet, so grade is omitted.

ports.name: I/O Port
ports.note: 64x64-channel option-card expansion slot for 3rd-party AoIP cards (e.g. Dante, Waves) or A&H SLink/ACE cards, sold separately; base unit ships without a card fitted. Connector shown here per the rear-panel diagram — actual connector depends on the installed card (low confidence on this specific field).

ports.name: Network
ports.note: Fast Ethernet (100Mbit/s) control port over Cat5, for MIDI-over-TCP/IP mixer control and SQ MixPad/SQ4You/SQ Control remote apps via a wireless router.

ports.name: USB-A (SQ-Drive)
ports.note: Front/top-surface port for direct USB-drive stereo (96kHz/24-bit) or multitrack (up to 32ch@48kHz / 16ch@96kHz) record/playback, library/scene transfer, and firmware updates.

ports.name: USB-B
ports.note: Rear-panel USB 2.0 port for 32x32-channel, 24-bit/48-96kHz bidirectional Core Audio/ASIO/WDM streaming to a computer, plus USB MIDI DAW control.

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: Earthed 3-pin IEC C14 inlet; 100-240V AC, 50/60Hz, 90W max; adjacent two-pole push-button mains switch.
